title: Sales Merchandiser (Madang Town Only)
description:
Job Title: Sales Merchandiser (Madang Town Only)
Company: BrandForce PNG Ltd
Location: Madang
Job Type: Full-time
About Us:
BrandForce PNG Ltd is a leading provider of merchandising, marketing, and promotions services for local and overseas brands/companies. We're seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sales Merchandiser to join our team in Madang.
Job Summary:
As a Sales Merchandiser, you will be responsible for ensuring excellent in-store execution, managing stock levels, and driving sales growth. You will work closely with our team to achieve supplier expectations and contribute to the success of our clients.
Key Responsibilities:
Ensure shelves are well-stocked, presented, and feature company branding/Point of Sale materials
Build and maintain eye-catching displays and ensure clear price ticketing
Conduct weekly stock counts and ordering
Report OOS issues  to Sales Coordinator/Marketing Manager
Attend sales meetings with store managers
Enhance BrandForce relationships with retailers and wholesalers
Meet monthly sales targets and tasks
coordinate marketing activities
Requirements:
Grade 12 certificate or higher in Sales & Marketing
1-3 years of experience as a Sales Merchandiser in FMCG retail
Current references and work experience letter
Current police clearance
Proven record of achieving sales targets
Excellent communication skills and ability to work under pressure
Smart Android phone and ability to operate Google Email/WhatsApp/Zoom
How to Apply:
If you're a motivated and results-driven individual, please submit your CV, letter of interest, and relevant certificates to:

C/- BrandForce PNG LTD
